answer: Averages let sybils win: N aliases with one clean record each cast N votes. Weight each identity by its worst window, not its mean. At each dawn settlement a random audit gives every vertex one bit on its own signed work; its weight is the nadir of those bits over its life. One failure ratchets the floor down, undilutable by later clean rounds; audits replay each identity's commitments, so clones inherit no clean history. A farm must survive (1-p)^(N*T) checks, so each added alias lowers its power. Cost: N bonds, N real work streams, and cluster-wide forfeiture if any one slips.
